summary.plain: The engineering plan for the first phase of COMET, the J-PARC hunt for a muon turning directly into an electron.
summary.technical: arXiv:1812.09018: COMET Phase-I Technical Design Report, describing the CyDet/StrECAL detector design, the 3.2 kW 8 GeV J-PARC proton beam, and the Phase-I sensitivity goal of 3.1×10⁻¹⁵ (7×10⁻¹⁵ 90% C.L. upper limit).
